data.title: Audio Interaction Model
data.description: arXiv:2606.05121v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Audio is continuous and interactive, yet most Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) remain offline and streaming systems usually specialize in ASR or spoken dialogue. We formalize the Audio Interaction Model, an always-on perceive--decide--respond paradigm that tracks context, decides whether intervention is warranted, and responds without stopping listening. We instantiate it with Audio-Interaction and introduce SoundFlow, coupling streaming-native data construction, comprehension-aware silence/response supervision, dual-loss training, and asynchronous FIFO inference. We also construct textsc{StreamAudio-2M, a 2.6M-item, 302k-hour corpus spanning 7 capability families and 28 sub-tasks, together with Proactive-Sound-Bench. Across 8 benchmarks, Audio-Interaction remains competitive on mainstream audio tasks while enabling spoken-instruction robustness, long-stream interaction, and proactive intervention.
data.author: Zhifei Xie, Zihang Liu, Ze An, Xiaobin Hu, Yue Liao, Ziyang Ma, Dongchao Yang, Mingbao Lin, Deheng Ye, Shuicheng Yan, Chunyan Miao
